heading: Foundation of Excellence
description: Anjani Machines Pvt. Ltd. was established under the leadership of Shri Kiranbhai Patel, laying the foundation for a company driven by engineering excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction.

heading: First International Milestone
description: Successfully completed our first export order, marking the beginning of Anjani’s presence in international markets.

heading: Expansion & Consolidation
description: All manufacturing operations were consolidated into a modern facility under Heatex Industries Limited, strengthening our manufacturing capabilities and operational efficiency.

heading: Introduction of the Next-Generation U-Type Jet Dyeing Machine
description: Successfully introduced our next-generation U-Type Jet Dyeing Machine featuring an advanced 9-segment design, engineered to provide smooth fabric movement, superior dyeing quality, and enhanced processing efficiency.

heading: Entering Sustainable Processing Solutions
description: Successfully designed, manufactured, and commissioned our first Caustic Recovery Plant with a capacity of 7,500 LPH for a leading textile processing company in Maharashtra.

heading: The Return of the Anjani Brand
description:
To revive the trusted legacy of the Anjani name, ANJANI INDUSTRIES was established in October 2019, carrying forward the brand with the vision of delivering innovative textile dyeing machinery under the tagline:

“The Dyeing Machine Company.”

heading: A New Generation of Dyeing Technology
description: Launched the ANJANI Low Liquor Ratio ECO+ Soft Flow Dyeing Machine, featuring reduced liquor ratio, shorter processing time, intelligent PLC automation, and enhanced energy efficiency—setting new benchmarks in textile dyeing technology.

heading: Industry Recognition
description: Recognized among the Top 10 Textile Machinery Manufacturing Companies by Industry Outlook, reflecting our commitment to engineering excellence and innovation.

heading: Growing Customer Trust
description: Successfully supplied, installed, and commissioned more than 20 ANJANI Low Liquor Ratio ECO+ Soft Flow Dyeing Machines, reinforcing our reputation as a trusted partner for textile manufacturers.

heading: Expanded manufacturing capabilities.
description: Add CNC Press brake machine for accuracy of plate bending.

heading: Growing Customer Trust
description: Successfully supplied, installed & commissioned of more than 80+ ANJANI Low Liquor Ratio ECO+ Soft Flow dyeing machines, in last 4 years.

heading: Growing Customer Trust
description:
In 2025, ANJANI INDUSTRIES had successfully supplied, installed, and commissioned over 180 textile dyeing and processing machines, including U-Type Jet Dyeing Machines, Long Tube Jet Dyeing Machines, and Newright Machines, for new textile processing units in Surat, Gujarat.

This milestone reflects the growing trust of textile manufacturers in ANJANI INDUSTRIES for delivering reliable, high-performance, and innovative textile processing solutions.
Over 36 years of engineering excellence, serving textile manufacturers across India and international markets.

With over 36 years of engineering excellence, ANJANI INDUSTRIES continues to innovate and deliver advanced textile dyeing and processing solutions that help customers improve productivity, reduce operating costs, and achieve sustainable manufacturing.
